677:t_052:1.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「Has the time come for this endless hatred to be extinguished?」

677:t_052:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Have you come to laugh at me, $$頭翅#pilot$$?」

677:t_052:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And you too, $$アポロニアス#pilot$$.」

677:t_052:6.en:
$$不動$$
「...Even if it was to deceive the eyes of the $$御使い$$s, I should apologize for hiding everything.」

677:t_052:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Enough... It is not such words that I want.」

677:t_052:8.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「$$ミカゲ$$... Return into me now.」

677:t_052:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am the hatred within you... If you take that in, you will be seized by despair.」

677:t_052:10.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「That will not happen. In the fighting between the Wingless... and humanity, I came to know them.」

677:t_052:11.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「And I came to know that time has turned, and a new age is about to arrive.」

677:t_052:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Should I... leave it to them?」

677:t_052:13.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「Yes. And within me, you will learn the truth.」

677:t_054:1.en:
$$不動$$
「And I will accept you both.」

677:t_054:3.en:
$$不動$$
「Let us watch over the next generation together. ...Sleep within me, $$天翅$$s.」

677:t_054:4.en:
$$不動$$
「Across time, we are united in this era.」

677:t_054:5.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「A man who betrayed me not once but twice... And yet why... are you so... warm...」

677:t_054:6.en:
$$不動$$
「You too have come to know harmony. This is the truth that leads to $$シンカ$$...」

677:t_054:8.en:
$$不動$$
「Even nothingness, a state of having nothing at all... even the void becomes a donut once a ring wraps around it.」

677:t_054:9.en:
$$不動$$
「It is a simple thing. To join hands and live together... that is what turns nothing into something.」

677:t_054:12.en:
$$不動$$
「To understand others, accept them... and then advance together into the future.」

677:t_054:13.en:
$$不動$$
「That is what lets lives, small and frail one by one, go on in this dark and endless universe... That is the truth of life.」

677:t_054:14.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
「Both $$ミカゲ$$ and I came to know its meaning. In all the many forms of love... between human and $$天翅$$, $$天翅$$ and $$天翅$$, human and human...」

677:t_054:15.en:
$$不動$$
「$$アポロ$$, $$アマタ$$... and you $$エレメント$$s. That is all I had to teach you.」

677:t_054:17.en:
$$不動$$
「Parting is the beginning of a new journey...」

677:t_054:18.en:
$$不動$$
「The Book of the Azure Star ends, and here and now the Book of All Stars begins! Farewell!」

677:t_055:1.en:
$$シリウス$$
「To think that person's true identity was...」

677:t_055:3.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「You're right. He chose to live as $$不動$$.」

677:t_055:4.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「And together with $$ミカゲ$$ and $$頭翅#pilot$$, he entrusted the future to us.」

677:t_055:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Thank you, Supreme Commander $$不動$$... From now on, we'll head toward the future on our own wings.」

677:t_056:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「More! Give me more! Let's go all out!!」

677:t_057:0.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$レイ#pt231$$! Look down there for a second!」

677:t_057:3.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「This... are you giving it to us?」

677:t_058:0.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「No way! Isn't this the live video disc from the showdown with $$ゲペルニッチ$$!」

677:t_058:1.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「So this is that thing rumored to circulate underground... It's my first time seeing a real one.」

677:t_058:3.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Thank you. Once we've watched it, we'll sign it and return it to you.」

677:t_058:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Since we're here! I'll sing for you, too!!」

677:t_100:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「The data on your combat capability has already been collected by the slaves of this unit.」

677:t_100:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Advisory. That data is already meaningless.」

677:t_100:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Incomprehensible. The data has been updated to the latest version.」

677:t_100:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$'s tactical judgment and this unit's ability to carry out instructions are constantly improving.」

677:t_100:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore even data from one second ago can be called a thing of the past.」

677:t_100:5.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Incomprehensible. Such a situation is impossible.」

677:t_100:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This is a fact.」

677:t_100:7.en:
$$レド$$
「Constantly growing is also a power of humanity! You, clinging forever to the old ways, can never defeat us!」

677:t_100:8.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$! By beating you, we will prove that the ideal you preach is warped!」

677:t_101:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Unidentified energy detected in the enemy unit's wings.」

677:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「My $$ＹＦ－２９$$ turns feelings into power! This too is human strength that you refuse to understand!」

677:t_101:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Anything outside this unit's range of understanding is judged a foreign body in an ideal society. Therefore it will be erased.」

677:t_101:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's because you try to eliminate what you can't understand, what you don't know, that wars break out!」

677:t_101:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm going through, $$ストライカー#pilot$$! With these wings, I have to deliver their song to the $$バジュラ$$!」

677:t_102:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! Your labyrinth of the heart has been destroyed! You're no longer...」

677:t_102:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If you have a heart, then say nothing and fight me with everything you have.」

677:t_102:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...Somewhere in a corner of my head, I have memories of when I was a winged dog...」

677:t_102:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「In them, you... $$頭翅#pilot$$ was happy next to $$アポロニアス#pilot$$.」

677:t_102:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...That is all in the past.」

677:t_102:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Let's go, $$ミカゲ$$! If you want to be freed from the past, I'll be your opponent!」

677:t_102:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll end this fight with you right here!」

677:t_103:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Looks like you've made up your mind, $$ミカゲ$$!」

677:t_103:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But I have no intention of being killed by you, winged dog.」

677:t_103:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If you think you can make me angry by running your mouth like that, you're wrong!」

677:t_103:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do you mean to show me mercy?」

677:t_103:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Not a chance! I never planned to forgive you from the start!」
